_comment: Pinned SHA-256 digests of the GitHub source tarball, one per release.
The panel refuses to install a release whose digest is not listed here.
This is the point of the file: the expected value is version-controlled
and reviewed by commit, so it is never read from the same place as the
archive it authenticates. A compromised upstream repository — or a
moved tag — can no longer feed arbitrary code to every installation that

A self-hosted fork that never publishes to GitHub Releases can set
NEXUS_UPDATE_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED=1 in backend/.env instead, which restores
the unverified flow with an explicit warning in the logs.
